description: This source file contains the implementation of the BufferConverter class, which performs audio buffer format conversion using AVFoundation's AVAudioConverter.

classes.name: BufferConverter
classes.description: A utility class to convert AVAudioPCMBuffer instances from one audio format to another.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an AVAudioPCMBuffer to a specified AVAudioFormat, returning a new buffer with the desired format.
